module: Flowgraph node "Get Time of Day" (category provider, tags environment/tod). Outputs the current time of day (core_environment.getTimeOfDay): time (0 to 1) and dayLength (duration of a day-night cycle in real seconds).
notes: Documentation inconsistency in the game: this node says "0/1 is midnight, 0.5 noon", while Set Time of Day says "0/1 noon, 0.5 midnight" and Random Time of Day "0.5 midnight". The Set Time of Day templates (0 = Midday, 0.5 = Midnight) and the Random Time of Day conversions go in the 0.5 = midnight direction.

work.desc: Every frame, writes time and dayLength to the outputs.
